name: Product Rail Gallery
summary: A shop section with a chrome clothing rail: garments hang from hooks, turn from profile to front on selection, tilt toward the pointer, and open into a detail overlay with front and back faces.
useWhen: An online shop or lookbook needs a showcase row of garments, with each piece selectable and viewable
Products have a colour, price and short description, and drawn garment art or a few photos are acceptable
avoidWhen: Shoppers need to compare many items, because the rail shows one selected piece at a time; use a product grid instead
The list has more than about twelve items, because each garment is a 3D element in the DOM; use a paginated grid instead
